rule: Fit the existing median assignment first. Fit a second assignment from each track's brightest max(min_observations, ceil(N/4)) observations. Align its palette to the current median palette. Change a team only when BOTH assignments are non-null. Keep all original unassigned tracks and preserve original palette/anchor and outlier decisions.
selection_reason: Fixes known shadow example while preserving original unassigned coverage; avoids promoting observations already rejected by the production model.
control_acceptance: More correct player observations, no increase in wrong or other-colour assignments, and identical unassigned coverage on the same labelled samples.
scope_limit: New temporal clips of the same match, single Codex image reviewer; no cross-match generalization or player identity claim.
